What happens when the Supreme Court takes years to decide a case and by the time it does, the law has been repealed, the detainee released or the election already held?
From the farm laws and electoral bonds to the detention of Sonam Wangchuk and the Maharashtra political crisis, several cases have raised questions about whether judicial delay can make meaningful relief impossible.
Watch Ruchi Bhattar's report.
